purpose: Rebuild the SfS++ preprocessing bundle for the handmade Juglet from its nine meshes with the current commit, and rebuild Pot A in the same job as the positive control (the t14_patches 15/15 bar). Stage 1 only: no assembly, no scoring against reference poses.
builds_from: git archive of the commit above out of the canonical checkout /data/gpfs/projects/punim2657/sfs_preprocessing; build tree deleted at the end of the job

sfs_overrides.SFS_SMOOTHNESS_DEG: ONLY on the bounded cluster retries for a piece that fuses to one cluster: unset(=4.5 shipped), 3.5, 3.0 -- at most three attempts, recorded per attempt in out/juglet_attempts.tsv

settings.pot_a: shipped defaults only, frozen-corpus axis files, exactly the p296 chain

inputs.juglet_clouds: /data/gpfs/projects/punim2657/sfs_preprocessing/Dataset/Point/Juglet/Juglet_Piece_1..9_Point.pcd (ascii, mesh vertices with estimated normals, no corpus manifest row -- the frozen corpus has no Juglet entry)
inputs.juglet_meshes: /data/gpfs/projects/punim2657/sfs_preprocessing/Dataset/Mesh/Juglet/Juglet_Piece_1..9_Mesh.obj (scan pose, mm) -- the family whose vertex counts match the clouds exactly
inputs.juglet_meshes_deviation: the brief named Dataset/Juglet/Piece01.obj..Piece09.obj. Those are the same pieces re-exported; they do not match the available clouds vertex-for-vertex and their names lack the _Mesh/_Point pair the stage derives, so the Mesh/Juglet family is used and both families' md5s are recorded in out/corpus_md5_before.tsv.
inputs.juglet_axes: regenerated in this run (out/boot/ PCA bootstrap for pass 1, out/axes/ PotSAC for the final pass). The pre-classifier Dataset/Axes/Juglet files are NOT used as SFS_AXIS_FILE.
inputs.pot_a: frozen corpus: Point/Pot_A/*_Point.pcd, Mesh/*_Mesh.obj, Axes/*_Axis.xyz, staged by scripts/stage_piece.sh with manifest checks

instrument.note: submit.sbatch, scripts/stage_juglet.sh, scripts/boot_axis.py, scripts/potsac_axis.py live in this run directory and are not part of the commit; their md5s are in out/source.md5
instrument.stage_juglet_reason: the frozen corpus cannot stage a Juglet piece (no cloud, no manifest row), so stage_piece.sh refuses; this stages the same Dataset/ tree from the mesh/cloud artifacts on Spartan

outputs.bundle: out/geom/ -- KEPT in this run directory; stage 2 consumes it (per piece: .S0.xyz, .S1.xyz, .Bl0.pcd, .Bl1.pcd)
outputs.logs: out/logs/ one log per piece and per attempt, plus out/juglet_attempts.tsv, out/juglet_pieces.tsv, out/classify.tsv, out/pieces_run.tsv

deleted_geometry: the build tree ($BUILDROOT/p07-build-<jobid>) only. Staged geometry stays because the run directory is the stage-2 input.
index_row: appended by this job's session with verdict and human_note left EMPTY
